summary: This bill directs the Secretary of the Interior to transfer approximately 124 acres of Bureau of Land Management land to the city of Price, Utah, for public use.

scores.thoughts: This bill directs the Secretary of the Interior to convey approximately 124 acres of Bureau of Land Management land to the city of Price, Utah, for public purposes. While land use changes can have environmental implications, the bill itself does not specify any particular environmental protections or deregulation, nor does it focus on environmental policy. The impact on environmental protection would depend entirely on how the city chooses to use the land, which is outside the scope of the bill's direct provisions.
